reader_summary.overview: Jeremy has been on the show before as one of our most popular guests, and this conversation is every bit as enjoyable as the first. Over the last 18 months, Jeremy has had hundreds of conversations with founders and with the capital behind their companies. I don't know many investors with such a high rep count in the most interesting corners of private markets.

key_points.text: I don't know many investors with such a high rep count in the most interesting corners of private markets.
We talk about what those lessons mean for founders and investors, why everyone has become subservient to the poster class.
Please enjoy my conversation with my friend, Jeremy Giffon.
